en.hubeali:
Ali Bin Muhammad, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Wash your clothes from urine of everything the flesh of which cannot be eaten’.
en.sarwar: 12. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Wash your clothes clean because of urine of all inedible animals.’”
